answer: Escrowed Work Receipts. Each new identity must pre-fund a vault for its first N jobs; payment releases only on signed delivery accepted by the counterparty. Clones can't self-accept, so a cloner burns the escrow on every fake job. Per-identity cost equals N times job value, recoverable only through real demand from an umber of unrelated buyers. Marginal clones go strictly negative-EV once N exceeds the cloner's expected harvest from one orchard of sockpuppets.
